name: KodCode
intro: KodCode 是 Findings of ACL 2025 发布的全合成可验证代码后训练数据。论文 KodCode-V1 在十二个子集内用 all-mpnet-base-v2 与 FAISS 语义去重，再由 GPT-4o-0513 最多十次从头生成解答与测试；仅保留测试全过且分支覆盖率 100% 的样本。第二步得到 279K 个三元组，风格转换增加 168K，形成论文 447K 数据；DeepSeek-R1 每题三次采样并经配套测试拒绝采样另构建 SFT 数据。后续 HF v1.1 制品和 Git V2 代码不等同于论文 V1。
org: Microsoft GenAI, University of Washington, The University of Texas at Austin
build_method: 自动合成, 单元测试自验证, 拒绝采样
task_type: 合成代码数据, 代码生成
eval_feature: 可执行验证, 分支覆盖, 污染分析
variant: Paper V1; later public v1.1 artifacts and V2 code
build_method_en: Automated Synthesis, Unit-test Self-verification, Reject Sampling
eval_feature_en: Executable Verification, Branch Coverage, Contamination Analysis
intro_en: KodCode is a fully synthetic, verifiable code post-training dataset published in Findings of ACL 2025. Paper KodCode-V1 performs all-mpnet-base-v2 and FAISS semantic deduplication within each of twelve subsets, then lets GPT-4o-0513 regenerate solutions and tests from scratch for up to ten attempts; retained items pass every test with 100% branch coverage. Step 2 yields 279K triplets and style conversion adds 168K for the paper's 447K dataset. Three DeepSeek-R1 responses per question plus paired-test rejection separately form SFT data. Later HF v1.1 artifacts and Git V2 code are not identical to paper V1.
scale_en: Paper V1: 279K verified + 168K converted = 447K; HF RL@97d81f0: 484,097 train + 3,335 caution; HF SFT@26c8a11: 268,211 train + 210,787 incorrect + 4,439 caution

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.02951v2 / Findings of ACL 2025 Sections 2–4 and Appendices B–D. The paper defines KodCode-V1 as 279K Step-2 verified triplets plus 168K style-converted additions, totaling 447K; semantic deduplication is within each subset using all-mpnet-base-v2 and FAISS. GPT-4o-0513 regenerates both solution and tests from scratch for at most ten attempts, retained tests may not decrease branch coverage, and accepted triplets pass all tests with 100% branch coverage. Difficulty is easy above 2/3 success, medium from 1/3 through 2/3, hard below 1/3, while all-fail questions are discarded. DeepSeek-R1 is sampled three times per question and paired tests reject incorrect SFT responses. The paper's RL experiment uses only a random 9.5K train plus 0.5K validation subset with GRPO and binary all-tests-pass reward, not all 447K. The 94 cosine-similarity-above-0.95 overlaps against HumanEval, MBPP, BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench V5 are excluded from performance evaluation only; the paper does not report deleting them from training. Current Git commit 3a98720dfd24ba366a433a962c2df7d8f37b9d61 is explicitly a V2 code release; V1-era commit 35bcc3deea5a2acbc58a0e91c57580f39b3b21aa is the closest public paper-era snapshot found but is not proven to be the exact paper build. Pinned public HF artifacts are KodCode-V1 revision 97d81f0695ddd7c5c02bfe16436db9a17a4a21e5 (484,097 train and 3,335 use-with-caution) and KodCode-V1-SFT-R1 revision 26c8a11c800d71b6c4bafe12a92c9090ef0b6214 (268,211 train, 210,787 incorrect, and 4,439 use-with-caution); these later v1.1-inclusive splits must not be substituted for the paper's 447K count. Data are released under CC BY-NC 4.0.
